title: A Will for the Alibi
author: E. M. Lockridge
blurb: Isandro Nystrom, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
